source: verified open-source stack for a private self-hosted search engine (meta-search UI + crawler + extraction + full-text index + client). All free/OSS.

components.name: SearXNG
components.what: Privacy-respecting meta-search engine: aggregates results from 200+ existing engines behind one self-hosted UI, no tracking.
components.capability: meta-search front-end (aggregate existing engines, privacy proxy)

components.name: Crawlee
components.what: Node/TS crawling + scraping framework (Playwright/Cheerio) for building your own index. Python port also exists.
components.capability: web crawler / scraper (build your own index)

components.name: Meilisearch
components.what: Fast, typo-tolerant full-text search engine (Rust). Self-hosted, simple API; the index behind your search.

components.name: Typesense
components.what: Open-source typo-tolerant search engine, a lean Algolia/Elasticsearch alternative. Alternative index.

components.name: OpenSearch
components.what: Apache-2.0 fork of Elasticsearch for larger self-hosted full-text + analytics workloads.
